draft.text: You came in for your yearly exam and to talk about your blood pressure.
Your blood pressure has been going up and down over the past few weeks.
It sometimes gets high and sometimes gets low.
You feel tense when your blood pressure is high and lightheaded when it is low.
You also get headaches when it is high, which you think is from sitting at your computer.
We will talk more about what to do next in your next visit.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because your blood pressure has been going up and down for a couple of weeks.
You also mentioned having headaches when your blood pressure is high.
We did not do any tests or check your blood pressure during this visit.
Your blood pressure is not staying the same, which can happen for many reasons.
You said you sit at your computer a lot and eat mostly frozen, processed meals.
We will talk more about what might be causing your blood pressure changes.
We will also discuss next steps to help manage your blood pressure.
